## Production Governance Checklist

- [ ] Branch was created from current `main`.
- [ ] Scope is limited and unrelated drift is excluded.
- [ ] No deploy was triggered manually.
- [ ] No Ads, GTM, Meta, GBP, Bing, Apple, Clarity, or tracking-gate mutation is included unless explicitly approved.
- [ ] `npm run lint` passed.
- [ ] `npm run build` passed.
- [ ] `npm run seo:validate-schema` passed.
- [ ] `npm run seo:link-audit` passed.
- [ ] Rollback plan is documented.
